items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Reunald Jones from the Atlanta band; Reunald Jones finally wound up, some years ago, he was lead trumpet fo Basie, back about 20 years ago.

ctx.x: And the hit song from On With the Show, was the song, 'Am I Blue,' and so Speed Webb, since he had prominent spot as a bandleader in the movie, he wanted to tour and do personal appearances, so he picked up me and my brother, Gus, and Roy Eldridge from Detroit and took us down to his home town in Muncie, Indiana, and he got Vic Zach Dickenson away from the White band, or the West Helmet band, another road band; and we spent oh, a couple of weeks down there in Muncie rehearsing, and he got some other musicians
from Indiana, Reunald Jones from the Atlanta band; Reunald Jones finally wound up, some years ago, he was lead trumpet fo Basie, back about 20 years ago.
Yeah, but that was senior, now.
